cohort: 77 infants born to HBsAg/HBeAg positive mothers
finding: Hepatitis B vaccine in combination with HBIG administered at birth provides immediate and long-term protection against HB virus infection in infants born to hepatitis B carrier mothers.
mod_finding: Infants born vaginally had a lower response to the vaccine compared to infants born via LSCS.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (LBW) was recorded in 45.4% of infants
